The chair has armrests on both ends, with chrome finish and rounded design.
The seat and backrest show visible wear, including scratches, scuffs, and discoloration on the black material.
The chrome frame has some minor scratches and tarnishing, especially on the legs and armrests.
The chair is placed on a black tiled floor, against a textured wall with a window blind in the background.
No brand or model markings are visible on the chair in any photo.
The seller's text claims it is 'Premium' and suitable for lobby, salon, clinic, or shop.
